title: Adorable
text: Adorable. I probably spent a little too much for this but it is adorable and very well made. I liked that it was only 35 in because I wanted to use it on my coffee table and it fits perfectly. Other than the $24.99 price I'm very happy with it.

product_metadata.title: Tirrito Cassiel Home Easter Decorations, Easter Table Runner 35 inch Embroidery Eggs Runner 13x35 Fireplace Mantel Decor Easter Gift
features: 【EMBROIDERY EASTER TABLE RUNNER】- A classical table runner to protect your table surface from hot dishes, scratches, spills. Feeling soft and comfortable. Durable material ensures non slip, fading-resistant, heat-resistant and easy to clean.

【TABLE CENTERPIECES】- Cute Easter egg with colorful flower chain embroidery table runner is a unique pattern to add a fun festive touch to your table. Great for Easter Day, parties in kitchen, dining room, fireplace mantel and more.

【EASTER EGGS DECORATIONS】 - This Easter Egg Chain Embellished Cut work Table Runner is a new design, brightens up any space. A fun present, decoration and surprise for your parents, friends, lovers on Easter Day, fireplace mantel, kitchen, dining, everyday use and more.

【MATERIAL & SIZE】- Made of 100% faux linen, high quality, unique texture with Easter colorful egg and flower embroidery. Dedicate hand-cut-work makes it a beautiful table runner. This table runner measures 13X35" in size.

【WASHING INSTRUCTIONS】- Use superior dye technology. Please machine wash colors separately with cold water on the gentle cycle. When drying tumble dry low. Slightly iron if needed. Bleaching is not recommended. Lay flat to dry.
